milestone.title: mp reviews — first-class code-review surface (comments + handoffs)

intent.outcome: mp reviews is a first-class code-review surface: structured comments and coordinator/runner handoffs can be recorded, read, and surfaced alongside the existing findings + verdict model, so review conversation is durable and machine-readable rather than living only in commit messages.

problem.description: BF-06: the mp reviews command surface (cli.rs:458) has only Status/Pending/Pass/List/Show/Sweep/Lifecycle/Finding. There is no comments subcommand and no handoff subcommand under reviews (a Handoff command exists under ExecutionCmd, not reviews). Code-review conversation today is captured ad hoc: findings carry description/status, verdicts carry notes, but threaded review comments and explicit coordinator/runner handoffs (who handed off, to whom, what data/evidence) are not first-class records. This makes multi-session review trails lossy — the M121/M122/M123 coordinator/runner/handoff skills assume a hand-off contract that mp itself does not persist.

in_scope: BF-06: mp reviews comment — add/list structured review comments on a milestone (author, body, optional finding link, timestamp)
BF-06: mp reviews handoff — record a coordinator/runner hand-off on a milestone (from-session, to-session, data, evidence) consistent with the mp-handoff skill's hand-off contract
Comments and handoffs surface in mp show milestone output (JSON) and are consumable by raul show
Storage in the existing reviews.json (or a sibling file) with the same atomic-write path other plan writes use
out_of_scope: Migrating the existing mp-handoff skill's markdown contract into mp storage — only the persistence surface
Real-time/streaming review (this is a durable-record feature, not a live channel)
The lifecycle/status correctness bugs (M131) and parallel-test stability (M132) — this milestone depends on those

acceptance_criteria.description: AC-01: mp reviews comment add/list creates and reads structured review comments on a milestone; each comment carries author, body, optional finding link, and RFC3339 timestamp, persisted atomically.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: M133 closed (BF-06 first-class code-review surface). Strategy: (a) added ReviewComment + ReviewHandoff models to mp-model with C-NN / H-NN id schemes and RFC3339 timestamps; (b) extended reviews.json with [serde(default)] comments/handoffs Vec fields for additive backcompat with pre-M133 plans; (c) added 4 new CLI subcommands (mp reviews comment add/list, mp reviews handoff) under ReviewsCmd; (d) wired review trail into mp show milestone output via inject_review_trail helper (default + --fields paths); (e) raul show consumes the new fields without breaking (verified). acceptance_criteria.description: AC-04: Closure — the full suite is green and the plan validates clean.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo test -p mp -p raul && mp validate --summary
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo test -p mp -p raul: 1382 passed, 3 ignored. mp validate --summary: ok=true error_count=0. BF-06 resolved into milestone 133. Code review applied: H1 (cmd_reviews wrapped in with_plan_write_lock — mirrors M113 cmd_milestone wrap, fixes the same race that bit M113 on the milestone surface), H2 (reviews_concurrent_writes.rs regression test fires N=8 parallel comment add + handoff records; pre-M113 wrap the last writer wins; with H1 fix all land with unique C-NN/H-NN ids), M1/L1 (next_comment_id/next_handoff_id docs clarified as plan-scoped, not milestone-scoped), M3 (dead if !path.exists() checks removed in add_comment + record_handoff), L2/L3 (dropped ambiguous 'four-point contract' wording from CLI help + record_handoff doc), L4 (--body help text says 'non-empty'), L7 (added missing-milestone assertion to reviews_comment_add_validates_draft). cargo clippy --all-targets clean; cargo fmt --check clean.

design_decisions.choice: Extend reviews.json (or a sibling review-thread file) rather than a new top-level file, reusing the existing atomic-write path.
design_decisions.rationale: Comments/handoffs are review records; co-locating with verdicts/findings keeps one review trail per milestone and avoids a new storage primitive.

design_decisions.choice: Mirror the mp-handoff skill's existing hand-off contract (data/session-boundary/evidence) rather than inventing a new shape.
design_decisions.rationale: The skills already encode the contract mp should persist; reusing it keeps the skill and the CLI in lockstep.

work_packages.name: Review comments surface
work_packages.goal: mp reviews comment add/list: structured review comments on a milestone (author, body, optional finding link, RFC3339 timestamp), stored in reviews.json via the atomic-write path. Surfaced in mp show milestone. On completion close the comments half of BF-06.

work_packages.name: Review handoffs surface
work_packages.goal: mp reviews handoff: record a coordinator/runner hand-off (from-session, to-session, data, evidence) consistent with the mp-handoff skill's four-point hand-off contract, stored in reviews.json and surfaced in mp show milestone. On completion resolve BF-06.

steps.action: Add a ReviewComment model (author, body, optional finding_id link, RFC3339 created_at) to mp-model, and extend reviews.json (reviews.rs:43 load_reviews / storage) to persist comments per milestone via the existing atomic-write path (store::atomic_write). Add mp reviews comment add <milestone> --author --body [--finding] and mp reviews comment list <milestone> subcommands (cli.rs:458 ReviewsCmd).
steps.done_when: comment add/list roundtrips and persists atomically

steps.action: Add a ReviewHandoff model mirroring the mp-handoff skill's contract: from-session, to-session, data, evidence, and which of the four hand-off points (a-d). Extend reviews.json storage. Add mp reviews handoff <milestone> --from --to --data --evidence [--point] subcommand. The record captures the session-boundary discipline the mp-handoff skill (templates/skills/mp-handoff/SKILL.md) already encodes.
steps.done_when: handoff records persist the full contract atomically

steps.action: Surface comments + handoffs in mp show milestone output (commands/show.rs) and ensure raul show consumes the new fields without breaking existing consumers. Backcompat: existing reviews verdict/findings shape unchanged; comments/handoffs are additive arrays.
steps.tests: cargo test -p mp show_milestone_includes_comments_and_handoffs && cargo test -p raul show_consumes_new_review_fields
steps.done_when: mp show emits comments+handoffs; raul show reads them; no shape break

steps.action: Closure: full suite green, plan validates; BF-06 resolved.
steps.tests: cargo test -p mp -p raul && mp validate --summary
steps.done_when: cargo test -p mp -p raul green, mp validate 0/0, then mp backlog resolve BF-06 --into-milestone 133
